impact: Formats other than 87/88 (e.g. DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM=28, DXGI_FORMAT_NV12=103) silently fall through to NV_ENC_BUFFER_FORMAT_NV12. DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8 is packed-RGB and would produce corrupt video. No real frame path reaches this yet (capture stub), but T-048 must add explicit format validation or an exhaustive match with error on unrecognised formats.
title: DXGI format mapping in push_frame_d3d11 silently treats unrecognised formats as NV12
